name: Saleem Sial
full_role: Lead Editor and Caribbean Cricket Researcher
description: Saleem Sial leads CPL Season coverage of tournament news, fixtures, team developments and host venues.
bio: Saleem Sial leads the CPL Season editorial desk. He oversees tournament news, schedule updates, team developments and venue coverage for the 2026 Caribbean Premier League.
His review process checks names, dates, grounds, competition status and official announcements before an update reaches readers. He also coordinates corrections when a published detail changes.
coverage_focus: Fixtures, teams, venues and major CPL announcements
method: Reviews tournament announcements and franchise updates before publication.
Checks names, dates, venues and competition status across related pages.
Coordinates material corrections and page update dates.
